```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)

```

```{r}
constitutive_td <- c(6,10,7,4,11)
specific_td <- c(13,14,9,5,1,2,3,8,15,12,16)
universe <- rownames(td_norm)

geneClusters_td <- list()

for (stage in specific_td) {
  stage_num <- match(stage, specific_td)
  geneClusters_td[[stage_num]] <- 
    universe[which(td_som$som$unit.classif == stage)]
}

names(geneClusters_td) <- specific_td
```

```{r}
compareClusterObj_td <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_td,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Omykiss.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = TRUE
)

compareClusterObj_td_nr <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_td,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Omykiss.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
## per‑gene SOM class (names = gene IDs)
gene_class <- tb_som$som$unit.classif
names(gene_class) <- rownames(tb_norm)   # same matrix you trained on

##–– tissue‑specific clusters –––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
tissue_df <- tb_som_info[
  tb_som_info$stage_specific     == TRUE  &
  tb_som_info$constitutive_class == FALSE ,
  c("tissue", "class_number")
]

##–– constitutive clusters ––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
constitutive_classes <- as.numeric(
  tb_som_info[ tb_som_info$constitutive_class == TRUE , "class_number" ]
)

##–– build the list –––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––––
geneClusters_tb <- lapply(
  split(tissue_df$class_number, tissue_df$tissue),
  function(cls) names(gene_class)[ gene_class %in% cls ]
)

geneClusters_tb[["constitutive"]] <- names(gene_class)[
  gene_class %in% constitutive_classes
]

# optional tidy‑up
geneClusters_tb <- geneClusters_tb[ order(names(geneClusters_tb)) ]
```

```{r}
compareClusterObj_tb <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_tb,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Omykiss.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = TRUE
)

compareClusterObj_tb_nr <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters_tb,           # named list / factor of gene IDs
  fun      = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb    = org.Omykiss.eg.db,
  keyType  = "GID",          # <- ***THIS FIXES THE ERROR***
  ont      = "BP",           # or CC/MF/ALL
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  readable = FALSE
)
```
